policy: Reuse concrete official AST operations first. Only required ordinary-library functions receive minimal specs/adapters; do not verify their libc/musl implementations. Direct system interfaces require concrete official support and a compatible world, never guessed stubs.

memcpy.source_behavior: Original C and AST unchanged; three arguments, destination-pointer return, raw byte copying, byte alignment and original non-overlap requirement preserved
memcpy.trusted_library_contract: Selected libc/musl memcpy is assumed to satisfy the stated C-library interface specification
